limitations: The claim concerns the designated EDN base specification. Tagged-value interpretation belongs to its tag steward. Application-specific schema declarations and the source evaluation of Clojure and ClojureScript have separate authority.

triggers: Recheck publisher corrections, material contrary evidence, revised notation or tool scope, or a changed Language Index policy.

statement: The EDN project specification describes base EDN as a textual notation for conveying values and identifies the Clojure program representation as a superset of EDN. It states that EDN has no schemas.
